items.claim: CFO 稱明年預期為強勁成長年，驅動力為 AI 投資循環，看不到改變
items.quote: we expect next year to be a strong growth year
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 最大客戶提供的滾動 8 季預測全年持續上升，歸因於 AI 系統需求
items.quote: rolling 8-quarter forecast we get from our largest
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 雲端業者資本支出預測全年上修，美系逾 7,000 億美元、全球近 1 兆
items.quote: over $700 billion this year for the U.S. companies
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 8 季預測因按工廠進單而非線性，呈跳升式成長；管理層看不到見頂點
items.quote: we don't see a place where it peaks
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 追蹤的新廠專案超過 100 座，最近兩季每季新增逾 10 座，作為領先指標
items.quote: well over 100 factories that we're tracking
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 中期受限因素為無塵室，需求大於供給
items.quote: in the medium term, it's gated by clean room
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 先進封裝去年營收 14 億美元，今年成長逾 70%，預期與先進邏輯及 DRAM 同步成長
items.quote: We've said this year, it's growing more than 70%.
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: ICAPS 今年預期溫和成長，明年為較正常的成長年（敘事相對過去兩年疲弱有變）
items.quote: We actually expect some moderate growth in ICAPS this year
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: ICAPS 正常成長的口徑：終端元件年增中高個位數，設備最終跟隨
items.quote: the devices themselves grow at mid- to high single digits
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: NAND 位元需求高但層數堆疊使所需晶圓減少，屬升級循環，設備市場較小且預期至少持續數年
items.quote: it makes that market smaller
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 面板級封裝目前仍在開發階段，已有設備營收但無量產；近期收購 NEXX
items.quote: I don't think there's any volume production at this point.
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 對 HBM 堆疊層數降低（de-speccing）的看法：設備端中性，未見需求減少
items.quote: we would view that overall as neutral
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 管理層否認公司只是跟隨整體設備市場，定位為最具賦能性的整合製程設備組合
items.quote: We certainly don't view it that way.
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 近期收購 X 光檢測公司與 NEXX，用於微凸塊檢測與面板細線互連
items.quote: We did the NEXX acquisition that I mentioned
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 公司已投資並持續投資，使每季產能達目前系統產量的兩倍；強調為產能陳述而非營收預測
items.quote: It's not necessarily a revenue forecast
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 將依元件類型彙整客戶 8 季預測並提供給 2,000 多家供應商，提前 8 季預告
items.quote: so that they're getting 8-quarter advance notice
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 近三年毛利率約擴張 300bp，其中相當部分來自定價，但管理層定位為價值反映而非漲價
items.quote: A lot of that has been on pricing, but it's not -- I don't
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 鋁、鋼、晶片、人力成本上升，因此需要往後調整價格
items.quote: So we do have to adjust prices going forward
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 價值定價適用所有產品，新舊不分，每期都須調整
items.quote: we have to make an adjustment each period
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 服務業務長期成長預期由低雙位數上調至中十位數，因安裝基數成長快於預期
items.quote: from low double digits to mid-teens
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 服務今年成長逾 20%，因產能利用率近滿載帶動備品採購；明年回到長期成長率
items.quote: We can't go to 110% next year.
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 服務成長拆解：安裝基數每年 5–7% 加上每台平均營收提升（含 AI 調校類新服務）
items.quote: installed base growing every single year. 5%, 6%, 7%
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: DRAM 單一年產能由約 160 萬片/月，今年新增 40 萬片，未來數年每年增 30–40 萬片，且為新廠
items.quote: 300,000 to 400,000 additional wafer starts a month
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: DRAM 數字口徑：升級廠設備投資約為新建廠的 25%；新建廠約 100 億美元對應 10 萬片/月
items.quote: about 25% of the equipment investment
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)

items.claim: 製程診斷與控制：電子束檢測需求顯著上升，驅動因素為 3D DRAM、4F²、GAA 到 CFET
items.quote: So the demand for e-beam is going up significantly
items.speaker: Brice Hill (CFO)
